premise: Duckling isn't sure about the pond and hides his head under his wing; Snail shows him that he hides too when things are new — and then peeks out, just a little — so Duckling peeks, dips one orange foot, then the other, and his webbed feet push like paddles: he floats!
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: nobody is unkind, and he finds his place by trying, one foot at a time.
learning: Ducks paddle with their webbed feet.

en-US.title: Duckling Dares the Water
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} It was a warm, sunny morning. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog sat at the edge of the pond, {frog:live catch-fly} catching flies. Snap! Gulp! {frog:face happy} "Come on in, {duckling:enter} Duckling!" {duckling:go to pond} Duckling waddled up to the edge. {duckling:face sad} The water looked very big. And very wet. [nervously] "Maybe tomorrow," he said, and {duckling:live nap hold} tucked his head under his wing. Slowly, slowly, up crawled {snail:enter} Snail. [gently] "Are you hiding?" he asked. "I hide too, when something's new. Like this." {snail:live hide hold} In he went. Then… {snail:live hide resume} out he peeked, just a tiny bit. {duckling:live nap resume} So Duckling peeked out too. {duckling:live dip-foot} One orange foot went in. {sfx:splash} Plip. Then the other. Plop. And then… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} his webbed feet pushed the water like paddles, push, push, and he was floating! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] "I'm swimming!" {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} QUACK! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Snail smiled. HE wasn't going in. But he'd come and watch. Every single day.

es-ES.title: Patito se atreve con el agua
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} Era una mañana de sol, calentita. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana estaba en la orilla de la charca, {frog:live catch-fly} cazando moscas. ¡Zas! ¡Glup! {frog:face happy} —¡Venga, métete, {duckling:enter} Patito! {duckling:go to pond} Patito se acercó a la orilla, bamboleándose. {duckling:face sad} El agua parecía muy grande. Y muy mojada. [nervously] —Mejor mañana —dijo, y {duckling:live nap hold} escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. Despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol. [gently] —¿Te estás escondiendo? —le preguntó—. Yo también me escondo cuando algo es nuevo. Mira, así. {snail:live hide hold} Y se metió en su concha. Luego… {snail:live hide resume} asomó, solo un poquito. {duckling:live nap resume} Y Patito también asomó. {duckling:live dip-foot} Metió una pata naranja en el agua. {sfx:splash} Plic. Luego la otra. Ploc. Y entonces… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} sus patas palmeadas empujaron el agua como dos remos, chap, chap, y… ¡flotaba! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Estoy nadando! {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live quack} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} ¡CUA, CUA! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Caracol sonrió. ÉL no pensaba meterse, eso no. Pero vendría a mirar. Todos los días.
